comment: For a 1.5 unit class, this was a lot of work. It doesn't feel like much work until the last half of class where you have almost 4 major projects due at the same time. She is an extremely nice person and her class is extremely practical, but don't expect an A to be easy just because it's a lower unit class. She expects high-quality work.

Too nice a person to give a 1 or 2 but unrealistic about students. See all students as overachievers (totally wrong, impossible) and teaches too many skills a person with integrity needs not to know. Make you feel nervous very early and then you can improve. However, according to her standard, there is no way for an imperfect student to get an A.
She was really great!  Love this lady!

Prof. Carey is AWESOME. She might be my favorite professor at UR. She is so helpful, the assignments are meaningful and I've applied what I learned on numerous occasions. I wouldn't take anyone else for Bus Comm!
Awesome teacher.. nobody would say otherwise.
Absolutely wonderful.  Couldn't recommend her more.  Probably the most practical class I've ever taken.
